canonical_name: Address Resolution Protocol — RFC 826 IPv4/Ethernet mechanism

last_known_use.notes: Continues as a normal IPv4/Ethernet neighbor-resolution mechanism; implementation evidence should be added separately.

addressing: Maps protocol-layer addresses such as IPv4 to link-layer hardware addresses such as Ethernet MAC addresses on the local network.
routing_or_forwarding: Supports local next-hop delivery but is not itself a routing protocol.

survival.provenance_notes: Long-lived within the IPv4 local-link environment; IPv6 uses Neighbor Discovery instead.
